original_metadata.name: CareerCompetencyModel
original_metadata.description: 研究当前外部世界对明确职业目标的能力要求，并生成带来源依据的结构化职业能力模型。
preconditions: 职业或岗位目标足够明确，可以开展外部资料研究
postconditions: 独立 JSON artifact 已写入工作区并通过 ReturnSkillResult 返回引用

compiled_metadata.summary: Researches current external occupational requirements and writes a source-backed CareerCompetencyModel artifact.
trigger_examples: Research the competency model for a senior LLM agent engineer in China.
What capabilities does the market currently expect from a healthcare product manager in the US?
Build a source-backed occupational competency model for an entry-level robotics perception engineer.
negative_trigger_examples: Assess whether I already have the abilities required for an LLM engineer.
Compare my résumé with this role and identify my gaps.
Create a six-month course and learning plan for becoming a product manager.
